author: NewVoltdrive
body:
Since people liked my top 5 Nebula maps thing, I decided to make another one. (And this might be a common thing. :P)

5. KooDaLord
You are probably thinking, "Why is he so low?" Well, although he is one of the best, if not the best aesthetic designers in Avicus history, the gameplay of most of his maps suck. Take The Divison. Easy to spawnkill. Plus, most of them just lag a lot. Nonetheless, he is a great aesthetics designer.

4. AwarriorVenom
A lot of what I said for Koo goes for Venom. Great aesthetics, poor gameplay. The main reason Venom is ahead of Koo is because Venom actually made stuff for Avicus, while Koo puts 90% of his maps on his network. Not to say Koo didn't at one time though.

3. ParaSpider
The first ever map dev, he is a map maker worthy of the title. He is a gifted terrain working, and a pretty good detailer. However, I was never a fan of most of his maps. (Although I haven't played a lot of them.) But, he is still a gifted map dev, and he is also a YML wizard. :P

2. G_SKIPPY
The name instantly triggers nostalgic memories of MC Zone. Although he is gifted in terrain work, he isn't the best detailer. However, he makes some of the best playing maps in Avicus history. Take Quintus. It is a fan favorite. It has everything you could ever want. Rapture is a really good TDM map, albeit strength pots are OP. He just does the maps good. And I would gladly play a G_SKIPPY map anyday.

1. Evocal
Well.....wow. He is the second map dev, but that doesn't mean that Para is better. Evo is about the same level in aesthetic design as Para. But, he is pretty good at making good gameplaying maps. The Justice series is a perfect example. It looks better than the Rendezvous series, yet, it is one of my favs, and is just really good. These are my reasons for him being the best map maker on the server.

Worst 2:

2. Voltdrive
He is a nub. A nubby nub.

1. Anyone who hasn't made a map
You can't get good at it if you don't try. It is beneficial to make a good map for Avicus, and you might just find a calling in map making. So, why don't you try it? 

That's my list. Thanks for reading. And I hope you share some of the same opinions.
